title: EWSB Bancorp, Inc. /MD/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: EWSB Bancorp, Inc., a small Maryland-chartered bank holding company based in Kaukauna, Wisconsin, filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2026 disclosing (1) the filing of Articles Supplementary authorizing up to 350,000 shares of Series A Junior Non-Voting Participating Preferred Stock and (2) that the company is considering a private offering of common stock to accredited investors.
key_points: EWSB Bancorp is a small regional bank headquartered in Kaukauna, Wisconsin (population ~16,000)
The company filed Articles Supplementary on April 23, 2026 authorizing up to 350,000 shares of Series A Junior Non-Voting Participating Preferred Stock
The preferred stock, if issued, carries no voting rights, is not redeemable, and is senior to common stock in liquidation
Holders of the preferred stock would receive non-cumulative cash dividends equal to common stock dividends
The company is considering a private offering of common stock limited to stockholders as of April 1, 2026 who qualify as accredited investors
Any securities issued in the private offering would rely on registration exemptions under the Securities Act
